idea-plugin.name: FontViewer
idea-plugin.description:
Preview font files (TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2) directly inside the IDE.

  • Custom text preview at multiple sizes with live glyph set
  • Glyph index with canvas rendering and filters (Unicode blocks, Private Use Area, custom range, exact lookup) — click to inspect metrics, copy text or SVG
  • Font metadata from the name table with clipboard support
  • Follows the IDE light/dark theme
